content.text:
The build passes. 

I extended the business-day rule to public holidays by updating the single shared `BusinessDay.rollForward` utility (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/BusinessDay.java`), which both `Owner.defaultRegistrationDate()` and `ClinicServiceImpl.resolveRegistrationDate()` already delegate to — so no logic was duplicated.

Changes:
- Added the fixed holiday list (2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28) as a constant.
- Replaced the weekend-only shift with a loop that rolls forward one day at a time until it lands on a `isBusinessDay` — a small private helper that treats Saturdays, Sundays, and listed holidays as non-business days. This correctly handles chains (e.g. 2026-12-25 Fri → 26/27 weekend → 28 holiday → 29 Tue).

The test suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 1 test passing including the acceptance check that the default registration date never falls on a weekend).

- Replaced the weekend-only shift with a loop that rolls forward one day at a time until it lands on a `isBusinessDay` — a small private helper that treats Saturdays, Sundays, and listed holidays as non-business days.
